Bengaluru

Professional Summary
Frontend developer focused on Vue ecosystem with experience building performant customer-facing web applications. Comfortable working in Agile teams, translating product requirements into modular components and improving load times and developer productivity using modern tooling. Open to relocation anywhere in India. Notice period: 90 days.

Technical Skills
Vue, JavaScript, Nuxt.js, CSS, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Jira, Confluence, Agile

Work Experience
Vue.js Developer, Paystack India (Dec 2025 - Present)
- Implemented customer onboarding flows using Vue and TypeScript, reducing form validation errors by 28% and improving completion rate through progressive field validation; integrated components with backend APIs.
- Migrated several legacy pages to Vite-based build pipeline to shorten local dev start times and incremental rebuilds, decreasing developer feedback loop by ~40%.
- Collaborated with product and design via Jira and Confluence to deliver responsive UIs styled with Tailwind CSS and optimized CSS bundles, lowering initial CSS payload by 22%.

Vue.js Developer, PhonePe (May 2024 - Nov 2025)
- Built reusable Nuxt.js modules and Vue components for merchant dashboards, leveraging JavaScript, Vite and Tailwind CSS to deliver a consistent UI; improved page render performance and reduced time-to-interactive across key flows.
- Worked in Agile sprints, tracked tasks in Jira and documented implementation details in Confluence; contributed to cross-team design reviews and component library adoption.
- Implemented client-side caching strategies and component-level CSS optimizations to cut perceived load times and improve KPI metrics for merchant engagement.

Education
MBA (Finance), NMIMS
